item.title: Pickleball for a Cause: Tournament Raises Thousands for Lung Cancer Awareness
item.description: Over 100 participants gathered in Honolulu for the third Annual Lung Force Pickleball Tournament, successfully raising $30,350 for lung cancer awareness and research, exceeding their $25,000 goal.

item.description: Bhubaneswar: Several shops were gutted after a massive fire at a market complex in the Dhauli area of Bhubaneswar, Odisha, late Monday night, officials said. The blaze broke out around 11 pm and rapidly spread to adjacent units as large quantities of inflammable materials, including plywood and plastic, were stored inside the four-storey building. item.title: Nani And Sujeeth’s Bloody Romeo Shoot To Begin This Summer
item.description: Nani and director Sujeeth have officially titled their upcoming collaboration Bloody Romeo. The film, showcasing Nani in a gangster role disguised as a chef, promises stylish action, dark comedy, and pan-Indian release. While the pooja took place in October last year, the makers have confirmed that shooting will start this summer under the banner of Niharika Entertainment.
